newsitem.title: GERMANY: Free newspapers in Germany post slow growth.
newsitem.headline: Free newspapers in Germany post slow growth.

text.p: German free newspapers posted only moderate growth in ad income for the second year in a row in 1996, an industry association said on Wednesday.

With a 3.2 percent climb in advertising income to 3.011 billion marks, the association of German advertising pages (BVDA) said the relatively slow expansion reflected the weakness of the country's retail market.

"The difficult situation of the retail industry, our most important customer group, has left its traces on this local medium, which in recent years has had the relatively highest rates of growth in the print media business," the BVDA said in a statement.
Free newspapers are local, unsolicited publications which are supported purely by their ads.
